content: Anqam n Wudayen x řɛedyan nsen

Deg uyur wiss tenɛac, wenni d ayur n Adar, deg wass wiss třeṭṭac zeg uyur nni, umi dd-tiweḍ řweqt i di tuɣa ad ggen awař n ujeǧid d uzerf nnes, deg wass i di tuɣa ttrajan řɛedyan n Wudayen ad xasen mmenḍaren, tuɣa řḥař s řɛeks, maɣar Udayen mmenḍaren x yinni ten icarhen.

Ssmunen Udayen di tneddam nsen di marra lɛamalat n ujeǧid Aḥacwiruc, maḥend ad wten inni tuɣa ittexsen ad daysen ggen řɣar, uca uřa d ijj izemmar ad iqqim ibedd zzatsen, minzi marra řegnus tuɣa fecřen s tiggʷudi zeg Wudayen.
Marra řḥukkam n lɛamalat d ijeǧiden i iǧan sadu ujeǧid d lwulat d imsexxaren n ujeǧid wcin afus i Wudayen, minzi tiggʷudi n Murdaxay tewḍa xasen,
minzi Murdaxay tuɣa ɣares ccan di taddart n ujeǧid uca řexbar nnes iffeɣ ɣar marra lɛamalat, minzi aryaz Murdaxay tuɣa ṣṣulṭa nnes tarenni ɛad.
Ɣeřben Wudayen marra řɛedyan nsen am ten ccaten s ssif, s wenɣay d uhellek. Ggin ak-d yinni ten icarrhen am mammec xsen nitni.
Di lqelɛa n Cucan nɣin u hellken Udayen xemsa-mya n yeryazen.
Uřa d Farcandata d Dalfun d Acfat
d Furata d Adalya d Aridata
d Farmacta d Arisay d Ariday d Wayzata,
ɛecra n iḥenjiren n Haman, mmis n Hamadat, řeɛdu n Wudayen, nɣin ten, maca war sswiẓẓḍen ca ifassen nsen ɣar tkeccaḍt.
Deg wass nni d ijj iwyen-dd qedda n imettan zzat i wudem n ujeǧid di lqelɛa n Cucan.

Inna ujeǧid i tjeǧidt Istir: “Di lqelɛa n Cucan Udayen nɣin u hellken xemsa-mya n yeryazen uřa d ɛecra n iḥenjiren n Haman. Min ɣa yiři ggin ɛad di lɛamalat nneɣni n ujeǧid? Min din ɛad ɣarem d asitem? Ad am immewc! Min tessitimed? Ad ɣarem yiři!”
Xenni tenna Istir: “Mařa mliḥ i ujeǧid, ejj ad immewc ttesriḥ i Wudayen i iǧan di Cucan uřa d tiwecca maḥend ad ggen ɛlaḥsab azerf n wass-a, uca ejj ad ayřen ɛecra n iḥenjiren n Haman ɣar teḥnact.”
Xenni inna ujeǧid maḥend ad ggen amenni. Řexdenni ittwassuffeɣ-dd ijj n uzerf di Cucan uca uyřen ɛecra n iḥenjiren n Haman.
Udayen nni iǧan di Cucan, munen ɛawed deg wass wiss arbeɛṭac n uyur n Adar uca nɣin teřt-myat n yeryazen, maca war sswiẓẓḍen ca ifassen nsen ɣar tkeccaḍt.

Munen ɛawed Wudayen nneɣni di lɛamalat n ujeǧid ḥima ad kkaren di ṭṭweɛ n tudart nsen u ḥima ad ṭṭfen řehna zi ɣar řɛedyan nsen. Nɣin xemsa u-sebɛin-ařef n yeryazen jar inni ten icarrhen, maca war sswiẓẓḍen ca ifassen nsen ɣar tkeccaḍt.
Ařeqqem n řɛid n ‘Purim’
Man aya imsar deg wass wiss třeṭṭac n uyur n Adar u deg wass wiss arbeɛṭac zzayes areyyḥen uca ggin t d ijj n wass n zzardet d řefraḥet.
Udayen nni iǧan di Cucan, munen deg wass wiss třeṭṭac n uyur uřa deg wass wiss arbeɛṭac uca nitni areyyḥen deg wass wiss xemmesṭac uca ggin t d ijj n wass n zzardet d řefraḥet.
X uya Udayen, inni iǧan di řkampu, inni izeddɣen deg tneddam břa řeḥyuḍ, ggin ass wiss arbeɛṭac n uyur n Adar d ijj n wass n řefraḥet d zzardet d řxar, ass i di ssekkan arriɣalut ijj i wenneɣni.
Izemmem Murdaxay imezruyen-a uca issekk tibratin i marra Udayen nni iǧan di marra lɛamalat n ujeǧid Aḥacwiruc, i yinni iǧan yudsen d inni iǧan iggʷejen,
maḥend ad ten arren ad ḥḍan ass wiss arbeɛṭac n uyur n Adar uřa d wass wiss xemmesṭac zzayes zeg useggʷas ař aseggʷas nneɣni

- ɛlaḥsab ussan i di ṭṭfen Udayen arraḥet zi řɛedyan nsen, u ɛlaḥsab ayur nni tuɣa i d asen ibeddřen zi řeḥzen ɣar refraḥet u zeg wecḍan ɣar wass aṣebḥan - ḥima ad ten arren d ussan n zzardet d řefraḥet u ḥima kuř ijj ad issekk aɣiralut i wenneɣni u ḥima ad wcen i imezřaḍ.
Qebřen Wudayen min bdan ad ḍfaren ɛad u min d asen yuran s ufus n Murdaxay,

minzi Haman, mmis n Hamadata, Ajaji, řeɛdu n marra Udayen, tuɣa ittxarreṣ ijj n wenway ḍidd i Wudayen maḥend ad ten ihellek, u netta tuɣa inḍar ‘Pur’, aqa-t d taqedduḥt, ḥima ad ten yareddeǧ u ad ten ihellek.
Maca umi dd-tusa Istir zzat i wudem n ujeǧid, yumur netta s tira maḥend ad yarr x uzeǧif nnes anway-a d aɛeffan, tenni tuɣa ixarreṣ ḍidd i Wudayen, uca uyřen t, netta d iḥenjiren nnes, ɣar teḥnact.
X uya řaɣan ussan-a ‘Purim’, zeg isem n ‘Pur’. X uya, zi ssibbet n wawařen n tebrat-a u zi ssibbet n min ẓrin s yixef nsen zi man aya u zi ssibbet n min d as imsaren,

kkaren ad ḥḍan ussan-a uca qebřen Wudayen i yixef nsen u i zzariɛet nsen u i marra inni ɣarsen dd-iqqnen, maḥend war ssɛeddun ca ad ḥḍan tnayen n wussan-a am mammec yura u ɛlaḥsab řweqt i ɣarsen ittwaggen i kuř aseggʷas,
uca ad idaren u ad ḥḍan ussan-a di kuř jjiř, di kuř řaǧ, di kuř lɛamala u di kuř tandint u war ssɛeddun ca ussan-a n Purim jar Wudayen u war ittᵉttwagg uneggar ɣar řidaret nsen s zzariɛet nsen.
Tura tjeǧidt Istir, yeǧis n Abiḥayil, ict n twařa nneɣni jmiɛ ak-d Wuday Murdaxay, s marra tizemmar nsen, ḥima ad ggen asecni di tebrat-a wiss tnayen x tmesřact n Purim.
Issekk tibratin i marra Udayen di mya u-sebɛa u-ɛicrin n lɛamalat n tgeldit n Aḥacwiruc, jmiɛ ak-d wawařen n řehna d řaman,

ḥima ad neyycen ussan-a n Purim di řweqt nsen ittwaggen, am mammec d asen yumur Wuday Murdaxay, jmiɛ ak-d tjeǧidt Istir, u am mammec ggin x yixef nsen u x zzariɛet nsen, ak-d řumurat x uẓummi d uweṭṭu nsen n ugejdur.
X řumur n Istir bedden wawařen-a x Řɛid n Purim uca man aya ittwara deg ijj n wedlis.
